# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration 2/3. Parent = cand_0001 (val 0.244: 1 solid=160-6 / 2 flaky=438-18,168-17 / 7 failing). Prompt-only capability. Reader = Qwen3-8B (weak-ish → prefer explicit, imperative, worked steps).

## Diagnosis (grounded in THIS iteration's ./trajectories/, read via 3 parallel subagents)
NO environment faults this iteration (cand_0001's PROCESS flagged 49945 as an infra timeout; in THIS run 49945 produces an output file with a real value mismatch — a genuine capability failure). The dominant, cross-cutting root cause on ALL 9 failing/flaky tasks: **the agent never actually EXECUTES the INSPECT or VERIFY steps** the prompt already lists. It guesses column/row coordinates from the truncated preview, emits a bare `save` block, and re-sends near-identical code across rounds. Restating the rule cannot fix this (cand_0001 already added the steps and they are skipped) — the fix must change STRUCTURE so the steps are unavoidable.

Second, distinct root cause on 168-17 (flaky): the parent prompt's own wording ("a verification turn re-opens output_path") **causes** the failure — when that read-only block becomes the final graded block, the grader replays it on copies 2/3 whose output file does not exist yet → it writes nothing → 0. This is a CONFLICT the parent introduced.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | lever used |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | INSPECT never executed → reads from wrong column/row | 49945 (crit col C vs F), 43213 (avg empty col B not source col A), 52532 (header-row off-by-one), 188-39 (5- vs 4-col merged header), 56915 (merged-cell headers) | Coordinates guessed from preview; no printed inspection ever runs. | BEHAVIORAL (skipped step) + KNOWLEDGE | force TURN 1 = inspect-only (print, no save); add "locate the data" pitfalls |
| 2 | final graded block is not self-contained → fails on replay | 168-17 (flaky), + general risk to all | Read-only "verify" block reopens output_path; on replay copies have no output file → 0. Parent prompt caused it. | CONFLICT / CONTRACT | self-contained-final-block contract; verify in the SAME block that loads+saves |
| 3 | VERIFY faked/absent → stops on unchecked output | all failing + both flaky | "Verification" was absent or a no-print re-save; agent never compares read-back. | BEHAVIORAL (skipped step) | read-back print is step (d) of the one solve block; finish only after it prints target cells |
| 4 | header-row offset on Sheet-Level copies (flaky) | 438-18 | Nondeterministic: sometimes writes data starting at row 1, clobbering the header. | KNOWLEDGE | "Right rows" pitfall + enforced read-back of the range |
| 5 | over-writes cells the task doesn't ask for | 53449 (filled 12, expected 2 — per-row instead of per-group) | Applied a row-level map where labels belong on group rows only. | KNOWLEDGE / CONTRACT | "Write only what is asked" pitfall (group/pivot → label group rows, not every raw row) |
| — | merged-cell lookups (two-key) — reasoning-hard remainder | 56915, 188-39 (key-lookup), 47766 (3-block SUMIFS) | Genuine reasoning beyond inspection. | (partial) | pitfalls + inspect help; NOT hardcoded (would overfit) |

## Changes made (one row per edit)
| # | cluster | lever class | file | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | 1,3 | ordered procedure (precondition) | task_template.md | Rewrote steps into TURN 1 = INSPECT ONLY (print sheets/headers/column letters/data extent/cells around answer_position; MUST NOT save), then TURN 2+ = ONE SELF-CONTAINED block: load input→compute→save→read-back-print. Finish only after a self-contained block prints the target cells. | UNBOUNDED (rewrites the per-task procedure) but the only passing task 160-6 already used a self-contained load-input→save block; inspect turn + read-back print do not change the SAVED output → reward preserved. |
| E2 | 2 | contract (add sourced rule) | prompt.md §grading | Added: replay hands the final block only the input file + empty output location, so the final block must load spreadsheet_path, compute, and save output_path by itself; a read-only reopen-output block scores 0. | BOUNDED additive contract; 160-6/438-18/168-17 self-contained solve blocks already satisfy it. |
| E3 | 2,3 | consolidate conflicting rule | prompt.md §working rules | Replaced the parent line "a verification turn re-opens output_path" (which caused 168-17) with "verify INSIDE the same self-contained block that saved; never split the read-back into a later output-only reply." | Removes the trap; no passing task relied on a separate verify turn (160-6 finished with no separate output-only block). |
| E4 | 1,4,5 | add rule / worked pitfalls | prompt.md §"Locate the data before you compute" | Four pitfalls: right column (key column ≠ raw column), right rows (top rows are headers; write below them), merged cells (value only in top-left; unmerge/forward-fill), write only what is asked (group/pivot → label group rows, not every raw row). | BOUNDED additive knowledge; each is a general domain rule, no task specifics. Passing 160-6 (delete blank rows) touches none of these conditions. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace line → what the edit changes on that exact input)
- **49945** trace: wrote `=SUMIF(C2:C11, C{row}, D2:D11)` — criterion from raw col C; correct keys are in col F (F4/F5/F6); never printed anything. E1 forces printing the column letter of "the list of models to total" and the cells left of G4:G6 → surfaces col F; E4 "right column" says match the key column not the raw column. Agent would use F, not C.
- **43213** trace: averaged column B (the empty "Average" column) → results LOWER; never inspected. E1 forces printing the header row → reveals col A = "Value", col B = "Average"; E4 "right column" → averages the source column A. Feedback "LOWER than expected" is exactly the wrong-column symptom.
- **52532** trace: looped rows 1–7 treating header row 1 as data → outputs shifted one cell + last player skipped. E1 forces printing where data starts/ends; E4 "right rows" says top row is a header, write below it. Fixes the off-by-one.
- **168-17** trace (flaky fail): the FINAL block reopened output_path only (no recompute) → on copies 2/3 that file was absent → wrote nothing → 0. E2+E3 make the final block self-contained (load spreadsheet_path→compute→save) and forbid a read-only final block → the failing trial's mode is eliminated; the correct behavior already in t0/t2 becomes the only allowed shape.
- **438-18** trace (flaky fail): started data at row 1, clobbering the header; no read-back. E4 "right rows" + E1 step (d) read-back print of A1:D6 → the header-preserving behavior (already in t0/t2) is reinforced and the offset is caught before finishing.
- **53449** trace: wrote a category into all 12 non-empty rows; gold fills only 2 (per-visit summary rows). E4 "write only what is asked" (group/pivot → label group rows, not every raw row; leave others at original value) targets the "10 cells changed that should keep their original input" feedback.
- **56915 / 188-39** traces: merged DATA-sheet headers read back as None → lookups failed, cells kept #N/A / wrong rows. E4 "merged cells" (unmerge/forward-fill before matching) + E1 printing the DATA header rows address the merged-header failure the user flagged. (Two-key match remains reasoning-hard; not hardcoded.)

## Blast-radius / SAFE statement
Only ONE passing task to protect: **160-6** (delete blank rows on sheet SH). Its winning trajectory was a self-contained `load_workbook(input)`→`delete_rows`→`save(output)` block — exactly the shape E1/E2/E3 now require. The added inspect turn and read-back print do NOT alter the saved output, so 160-6's reward is preserved. It touches none of the E4 pitfall conditions (no lookup, no header-fill, no group labelling). Flaky 438-18 and 168-17 move toward their already-correct trials, not away. E1 is the one UNBOUNDED edit; I enumerated the entire passing class (just 160-6) and confirmed no flip.

## Value-vs-formula decision (kept from cand_0001, not re-litigated)
Still LITERAL values computed in code, NOT live formulas: the in-sandbox verify reads back with no recalc, so a formula reads as None and defeats the read-back check. (Note 49945/47766 traces show the model writing `=SUMIF/=SUMIFS` formula strings — these DO get recalced at grading time so they can score, but the failure there was the wrong criterion/range, not the formula-vs-value choice, so I did not touch the value/formula policy.)

## Process & features used
- Parallel diagnosis: 3 background subagents, one per trajectory group (49945/47766/52532; 56915/53449/43213; 188-39/438-18/168-17 incl. flaky trials t0/t1/t2). I read 160-6 (passing) myself to fix the protect-set. Diagnosis is trace-grounded, not from the summary.
- Prior iterations: built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, +0.096) — kept its openpyxl-in-place method, compute-from-data, and type rules; did NOT re-add anything it broke (it broke nothing). This iteration attacks the residual "steps are listed but skipped" problem with structure, which cand_0001 left open.

## Deliberately skipped / not cracked
- 47766 (3-block SUMIFS over a date range) and the two-key merged-cell match in 56915/188-39 have a genuine reasoning component; I added inspect + merged-cell + "use all ranges" knowledge to help but did NOT encode task-specific logic (would overfit and be rejected by the held-out gate).
- Wasted code-less `<think>`-only rounds persist; the one-code-block rule from cand_0001 is kept but not further emphasized (repetition won't move a behavioral skip).
